notes.title: Changes 1.0
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Due to the reviews we receive, and with the mission to improve the game, we decide to make the following changes:

-Environment lighting
-Assets
-Playability
-And last but not least, the price.

We want to clarify and remind you that the time it may take to complete the game, is not always the same as the time it takes to play it, since the failed attempts are not counted in the final time.

We hope these changes will be welcome,

Tight embrace, 
Developer.
